crusadecraft.mapedit.enter.tip: Open the editor: place your own realms and towns, paint the borders.
crusadecraft.mapedit.leave.tip: Leave the editor and go back to your map.
crusadecraft.mapedit.title: Map editor
crusadecraft.mapedit.tool.choose.tip: Click a town to rename, move, give away or delete it.
crusadecraft.mapedit.tool.realm.tip: Click the map: the capital of a new realm goes there.
crusadecraft.mapedit.tool.city.tip: Pick its owner on the right, then click the map.
crusadecraft.mapedit.tool.brush.tip: Hold the click to paint borders. Right-drag to move the map.
crusadecraft.mapedit.hint.choose: Click: select a town · Right-drag: move · Wheel: zoom
crusadecraft.mapedit.hint.realm: Click where the new realm's capital should go
crusadecraft.mapedit.hint.city: Click where the new town should go
crusadecraft.mapedit.hint.brush: Hold the click to paint · Right-drag: move
crusadecraft.mapedit.brush.tip: Who the painted land belongs to. Shift-click: cycle backwards.
crusadecraft.mapedit.city.for.tip: Who will own the town. Shift-click: cycle backwards.
crusadecraft.mapedit.panel.empty.title: Nothing selected
crusadecraft.mapedit.panel.empty.body: Click a town or a territory to edit it.
crusadecraft.mapedit.panel.colony.body: Managed in the game: town hall and boundary stone.
crusadecraft.mapedit.city.move.tip: Then click the map where the town should go.
crusadecraft.mapedit.city.give.tip: Pick who will hold the town (you included), then OK. Shift-click: cycle backwards.
crusadecraft.mapedit.city.delete.capital: A capital can't be deleted on its own: delete the whole realm.
crusadecraft.mapedit.wipe.tip: Removes every realm the game created. Yours stay, and the game creates no new ones.
crusadecraft.mapedit.form.name: Name
crusadecraft.mapedit.form.faith.tip: Pagan and heretic realms are the targets of crusades.
crusadecraft.mapedit.denied: Only the game's host and operators can edit the map.
crusadecraft.mapedit.name_invalid: The name needs at least two letters.
crusadecraft.mapedit.too_close: Too close to %s: move a little further.
crusadecraft.mapedit.realm.not_ai: A player's realm is managed in the game, not in the editor.
crusadecraft.mapedit.wipe.done: Blank world: %s realms created by the game are gone. Yours remain.
crusadecraft.mapedit.city.no_host: A town of yours depends on a neighbouring realm: place an AI realm first.
crusadecraft.mapedit.city.deleted: %s has been removed from the map.
crusadecraft.mapedit.city.capital: This is the capital of %s: delete the whole realm.
crusadecraft.codex.carte.p1: The game's host can redraw the world: the map's $(l)Edit$() button.$(li)$(l)+ Realm$(): place a realm, with its name, rank, colour and faith.$(li)$(l)+ Town$(): a town for a realm, or for you.$(li)$(l)Brush$(): paint the borders.$(li)$(l)Select$(): rename, move, give away, delete.
